Use your address without giving it to Franklin Navigator.

Choose what you need to look up.

School zone

Franklin addresses may be served by Williamson County Schools or Franklin Special District. Check the responsible district directly.

  • Franklin Special District map & zoning

District boundaries and assignments can change; the official district makes the final determination.

Ward and local representation
